description: Sets the starting voltage for an envelope and blocks its triggers, for use with the Stage, Booster Stage and Hostage modules

params.text: Sets the voltage sent to OUT, within the range chosen by the UNI/BI switch
Raises the TRIG output to 10V while pressed, unless triggers are being blocked
Blocks triggers from both the TRIG input and the TRIG button while pressed
Sets the range of the LEVEL knob: 0-10V at UNI, or -5 to 5V at BI

inputs.text: A high signal here raises the TRIG output, unless triggers are being blocked; it reads high above 1V
While this gate is high, triggers from both the TRIG input and the TRIG button are blocked; it reads high above 1V
Modulates the level; every 1V here turns the LEVEL knob a tenth of its travel clockwise

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the TRIG input is high or the TRIG button is pressed, and 0V while triggers are blocked
Carries the LEVEL voltage, for use as the voltage an envelope starts from

notes: the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
